claim: Games may mirror graphics in place at run time; compare in-play graphics with the snapshot and take shapes from one consistent state, or masks come out mirrored.

evidence.text: Player frames 48-58 are mirrored in place at 43209 when he turns; a graphics diff between frames found 43209.
The first look's 61.5% byte match came from sprites mirrored at run time; real match 100%.
Wally's frames mirror on a turn, the spear carrier mirrors in place, and frame 0 differs from its snapshot bytes; found by a census by plot.
Writing the catalogue's graphic over a mirrored frame paired it with a mirrored mask (frame 98: 55 mask pixels on the wrong side); fixed by building shapes from one consistent state.
